UML:TaggedValue.value: 01_Requirements

The cooling water temperature, pressure and flow at the main engine inlet and outlet shall meet the requirements of the main engine manufacturer's technical documentation. The design parameters of the high-temperature and low-temperature cooling water circuits shall be consistent with the main engine technical data, pump curves, cooler selection and heat-balance calculations.

01_Requirements

The main engine cooling water system shall be designed to maintain the cooling water temperature at the engine inlet within the limits specified by the engine manufacturer. The difference between the maximum inlet temperature of the high-temperature fresh-water circuit and the thermostat opening temperature shall not exceed 36°C.

$XREFPROP=$XID={36D73CBA-ED47-41BE-AEB9-3C782509F493}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={36D73CBA-ED47-41BE-AEB9-3C782509F493}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The main engine cooling water pressure shall meet the requirements of the main engine manufacturer's technical documentation. The pressure in the low-temperature cooling water circuit shall not exceed 2 bar (based on the MAN 49/60 Project Guide; for other manufacturers, confirm against their Technical Data).

01_Requirements
The main engine cooling water flow shall meet the requirements of the main engine manufacturer's technical documentation and shall be verified through heat-balance calculations and pump curves.
